definitions.question_count: All host queries until the correct final submission, including repeats; excludes final-answer attempts.

secondary_prior_inclusive.note: Descriptive only: earlier 14-question run was resumed after a mid-game protocol change and is not pooled into the primary same-protocol estimate.

limitations: Only two new repetitions; variance estimate is unstable.
Host semantic labels and controller grading still require human review.
Agent contexts are separate but sampling seed and exact checkpoint are not exposed; statistical independence is not established.
Do not attribute differences solely to solver; host wording decisions can vary.
